title: A data storage optimization method for railway CTC system cloud platform
assignee: China Railway Construction Network Information Technology Co ltd

pse.problem: Data transmission delay and bandwidth pressure due to centralized data storage in railway CTC system, prone to single point failure, security and privacy protection issues
pse.solution_function: A method that combines edge computing, federated learning, and quantum computing for real-time collection of train operation data, preprocessing, local storage, model training, parameter uploading to the central server, aggregation, and update.
pse.solution_structure: Edge computing devices along railways and at stations (data collectors), edge computing device's local storage (for storing trained models), central server (for data aggregation and updates)
pse.solution_implementation: Data collection by edge devices -> First preprocessing of operation data -> Second preprocessing and initial storage -> Local training of machine learning model on edge device -> Saving of trained model parameters and structure in local storage -> Regular uploading of model parameters to central server for aggregation and update
pse.effect: Improved data storage efficiency, reduced data transmission delays and bandwidth usage, increased system availability, and enhanced data security and privacy protection
